other_failure_modes.name: Data-dependent feature engineering
other_failure_modes.description: Feature engineering steps conditionally create columns based on split-specific statistics (e.g., checking if the minimum value in the current split is greater than 0). This causes inconsistent feature sets across train and test splits, leading to missing column errors (KeyError) when slicing the dataframes.

summary: The agent builds a robust-looking pipeline with appropriate regression models and an inverse-RMSE weighted ensemble. However, the code contains critical implementation bugs: target encodings are computed but never applied to the training data, and data-dependent feature transformations (log transforms conditioned on a split's minimum value) cause inconsistent schemas between train and test sets, leading to execution failures. Furthermore, evaluation relies on a single metric (RMSE) and a single validation split.
